user.title: Inverter
user.description: Battery, solar panel and grid settings are made on dom.oti.cat, in Inverter automation. Each site there has its own token.

data_description.token: Shown when the site is created on dom.oti.cat.
data_description.load_entity: Total kWh used by the house, not counting battery charging. The plan learns the hourly pattern from its last 14 days.
data_description.grid_entity: Total kWh drawn from the grid, so the day chart can show the real grid cost. A signed meter that goes negative while exporting is fine.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Total kWh fed to the grid, if the meter keeps a separate export register. Used to price the hours that exported.
data_description.solar_entity: Total kWh produced by the panels. The day chart shows this measured production for the hours already past; future hours stay modelled.
data_description.zone: Zone used for the solar forecast and temperature. Home is Home Assistant's own location. To use another place, add a zone in Settings > Areas, labels & zones > Zones.
data_description.program_power: Battery power limit written to every time-of-use program.

data.heater_dry_days: Days without surplus to top up
data.heater_cheap_price: Cheap price during a dry spell (€/kWh)

data_description.heater_grid_entity: Grid power in W, signed or with the direction sensor below. The heaters run on the surplus it shows, and stop when it climbs too high.
data_description.heater_flow_entity: An entity whose state tells import from export, for meters that do not give a signed value.
data_description.heater_consuming_state: State of the flow sensor that means importing.
data_description.heater_surplus_w: The grid is kept around this value while heating on surplus. Usually 100 W.
data_description.heater_max_import_w: Ceiling on total grid import while heating on cheap grid, so it never trips the breaker. Set it a little under the contracted power.
data_description.heater_margin: Hysteresis band around the thresholds, in W.
data_description.heater_min_elevation: Do not heat on surplus when the sun is below this angle.
data_description.heater_min_azimuth: Do not heat on surplus while the sun is below this (morning shade). 90 = due east.
data_description.heater_max_azimuth: Do not heat on surplus while the sun is above this (evening shade). 270 = due west.
data_description.heater_dry_days: When the site has gone this many full days without exporting surplus, the heaters are probably running short: they may then also heat from the grid in the cheap hours. 2 doubles the roughly five real dry spells a year.
data_description.heater_export_min_kwh: A day counts as dry when it exported less than this. Usually 0.5.
data_description.heater_cheap_price: During a dry spell the heaters may also heat from the grid at or below this price. The thermostat caps the energy, so it only costs a few kWh a few days a year.

data_description.heater_1_entity: Switch or climate entity. Priority is the slot order: heater 1 runs before heater 2. Leave a slot empty to use fewer heaters.
data_description.heater_1_power: Power drawn while running, for the pre-flight check.
data_description.heater_1_hvac_mode: Mode set when turning a climate entity on (ignored for switches).

data_description.heater_2_entity: Switch or climate entity. Priority is the slot order: heater 1 runs before heater 2. Leave a slot empty to use fewer heaters.
data_description.heater_2_power: Power drawn while running, for the pre-flight check.
data_description.heater_2_hvac_mode: Mode set when turning a climate entity on (ignored for switches).

data_description.heater_3_entity: Switch or climate entity. Priority is the slot order: heater 1 runs before heater 2. Leave a slot empty to use fewer heaters.
data_description.heater_3_power: Power drawn while running, for the pre-flight check.
data_description.heater_3_hvac_mode: Mode set when turning a climate entity on (ignored for switches).

data_description.heater_4_entity: Switch or climate entity. Priority is the slot order: heater 1 runs before heater 2. Leave a slot empty to use fewer heaters.
data_description.heater_4_power: Power drawn while running, for the pre-flight check.
data_description.heater_4_hvac_mode: Mode set when turning a climate entity on (ignored for switches).
